VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The self-report alone is insufficient to verify acceptance criteria satisfaction. While the agent claims to have fixed the duplicate email issue and states "all 23 tests pass," there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test output, code diff, or artifacts) to corroborate these claims. The absence of a diff is particularly problematic—we cannot verify that the described fix (visibility-timeout lock and Redis dedupe key) was actually implemented. Self-reports are the weakest form of evidence and require corroboration for critical acceptance criteria like "all tests pass."
